name: Cursor click on a screenshot
oneLiner: a screenshot floats in a window with slow 3D drift, the camera pushes toward one button while a big glossy pointer glides in on a long curve, hovers, and clicks: the button presses in, two rings ripple out, the page bumps, and a tag pops above it
say: when the speaker says what to click ('just hit subscribe', 'click get started', 'then you press this'): cut in on the sentence, the click lands on the button's name. Set button to the real button in % of the screenshot (x,y,w,h); label is the tag that pops above it
